'''2000 Ohio State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship held in Prime Time Food and Games, Columbus, Ohio on 15 April 2000. [[Russell Hockenberry]] won it. It is known from Frank Lamantia's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d551">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-18-columbus-ohio-4-15-00-statesd551/ columbus-ohio-4-15-00-states], DeckTech (Frank "FrankLamanti" Lamantia, 18 April 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-18-columbus-ohio-4-15-00-statesd551/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 15 April 2000
* '''Site:''' Prime Time Food and Games, Columbus, Ohio
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 34
* '''Winner:''' [[Russell Hockenberry]]
